edition_scope: Released physical Terra Mystica base game. Rules claims are bounded to Feuerland Spiele's official German rulebook PDF v1.2 and the official product page; reception claims use two independent reviews. Expansions, the Automa Solo Box, later Big Box changes, and an exhaustive FAQ/errata inventory are excluded.

rules_denominator.notes: Static 20-page German PDF retrieved from the publisher; PDF footer identifies v1.2. Exact byte receipt and SHA-256 are recorded below.

faq_errata_inventory.scope: Public base-game FAQ or errata applicable to the claims published here.
checks: The official product page exposes the core rulebook and several supplemental downloads.
No separate FAQ or errata claim is published in this packet.
faq_errata_inventory.notes: A complete applicable FAQ/errata denominator was not retrieved and is not inferred.
